statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-58015 is a path traversal in the client side of the GDBus DBUS_COOKIE_SHA1 authentication mechanism (gio/gdbusauthmechanismsha1.c): the client does not validate the cookie_context sent by the server, so a malicious D-Bus server can make the client read an arbitrary file and learn its contents by checking guesses against the returned hash. Upstream fixed it in GLib 2.88.1 and 2.89.0 (https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/glib/-/issues/3931), and Debian backported the fix to trixie in 2.84.4-3~deb13u4 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-58015). This owner rebuilds Debian's trixie glib2.0 source. We unpacked libglib2.0-0t64 from every published build for amd64 and arm64. The three builds of Debian 2.84.4-3~deb13u3 do not carry the fix: their package changelog has no entry for this CVE, and their libgio-2.0 library lacks the "Malformed cookie_context" error that the fix adds. The three builds of Debian 2.84.4-3~deb13u5 do: their changelog includes the 2.84.4-3~deb13u4 entry that adds the patches from upstream 2.88.1 (the gdbusauthmechanismsha1 cookie-context validation patches) and names this CVE, and their libgio-2.0 contains that error message. The range ends at the first build of Debian 2.84.4-3~deb13u5, the first published build with the fix.
